summary: NewHold Investment Corp. III (SPAC) filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, regarding a Business Combination Agreement with NewCleo Ltd. and its subsidiaries. The agreement involves two mergers: Merger Sub 1 merging into SPAC, then surviving company merging into Merger Sub 2, with SPAC becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Newcleo. Terms (price, premium, implied value) and board recommendation are not detailed in the excerpt. The structure uses a dual-merger chain to re-domesticate. No advisor or regulatory clock mentioned. Watch for shareholder vote on de-SPAC and redemption risk.
